subject: Pilot briefing: requeue request to align with finance prioritization & exec travel
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@harbortech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@harbortech.com
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot briefing: integration pilot walkthrough

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

Thanks for the time last week. HarborTech is ready to move from discovery -> pilot, and procurement asked that we schedule a 90‑minute technical briefing next week to kick things off. High level: we want a short exec overview, an integration demo that shows data ingress and inference latency, and a checklist for PO / SOW readiness.

Constraints on our side: finance has a planning blackout the week of June 23–27 because of quarter close, and our CTO is traveling June 25–30. Ideally we want the briefing outside those windows.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 6/17 10:00–11:30
- Wed 6/18 14:00–15:30
- Mon 6/23 09:00–10:30 (less ideal due to close)

Attached: pilot_scope.xlsx (high-level asks + success criteria). Procurement is CC'd — they need an estimated timeline for PO and any standard T&Cs.

Alex
Director of Partnerships
HarborTech

Attachment: pilot_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@harbortech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot briefing: integration pilot walkthrough

Alex — thanks for the clear notes and the attachment. Quick internal read: finance blackout during Q2 close and your CTO travel mean the proposed 6/23 slot is risky. We also have a capacity constraint — several pilot demos are queued that week.

Two asks from our side before we lock a date:
- Can procurement share a target PO date (this helps our Ops schedule a reserved GPU pool)?
- Confirmation on whether you want a full end-to-end run or a focused integration + latency test. If the former, we need a longer window and will provide a runbook.

Given the constraints, can we move the briefing to the week of July 7–11? Suggested times (PT):
- Thu 7/10 10:00–12:00 (preferred)
- Fri 7/11 09:00–10:30 (alternative)

I'll attach a short one‑pager with agenda and roles. If procurement signals they need an earlier start, we can explore a condensed 60‑minute slot on 6/18, but that will be focused and non‑exhaustive.

Thanks — Rishi
Sr. Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Attachment: demo_onepager.pdf (1 page)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@harbortech.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot briefing: integration pilot walkthrough

+1 on avoiding the Q2 close week. Also flag: I'm out 6/24–7/02 for customer travel, so please avoid those dates for internal deep‑dive prep. Operationally, if we aim for 7/10 we should lock the reserved GPU pool by EOD 6/20 — Ops needs a PO or a formal pilot kickoff request to hold capacity.

If procurement can commit to PO submission by 7/6, we can do the full 2‑hour session on 7/10 and include a latency run. Otherwise, propose the condensed 60‑minute demo on 6/18 (Rishi/Marissa host, Neha on standby).

Neha
Customer Reliability Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@harbortech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@harbortech.com, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot briefing: integration pilot walkthrough

Thanks — appreciate the options and the operational note. Procurement confirmed internally that they can target PO submission by 2025-07-06 provided the SOW and estimated pricing are delivered this week. They also asked for a short calendar invite with attendee roles so they can route approvals.

We prefer the full walk (7/10) if Redwood can provide the simple runbook and the SOW draft by EOD Thu 6/19. If you can do that, 7/10 10:00–12:00 PT works for us. Otherwise we will take the condensed slot on 6/18 to keep momentum.

Alex

Confirmed for me — ops will tentatively hold a half‑day reserved pool for 7/10 08:00–14:00 PT pending PO or a formal kickoff request by 6/20. Rishi, can you confirm we can deliver the SOW + runbook by EOD 6/19? If yes, I'll convert tentative to confirmed and send a calendar invite with roles mapped (Eng, CS, Solutions).

If procurement cannot meet the 7/6 PO target, we should lock the condensed 6/18 60‑minute slot to keep the deal moving.

Karthik
